subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: Should maintainers make this PR the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit `/model` callback issue after the sort-order bug is fixed, or choose a sibling implementation instead?
rationale: Two open proof-positive PRs solve the same user-visible bug with different indexed callback contracts, and the provider/model callback contract affects model-routing behavior.

options.title: Fix This PR Then Use It
options.body: Land this branch after aligning the model sort invariant if maintainers prefer preserving existing name callbacks and using indexed callbacks only when Telegram's byte limit requires it.

options.title: Use The Sibling Candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 if maintainers prefer its broader indexed callback contract, then close or pause this PR to avoid parallel callback formats.

options.title: Hold For Owner Selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the callback contract, accepting the extra review round trip.

recommendation.title: Fix This PR Then Use It
recommendation.body: Land this branch after aligning the model sort invariant if maintainers prefer preserving existing name callbacks and using indexed callbacks only when Telegram's byte limit requires it.

likelyOwner.reason: The byte-limit refactor and current callback surface history make this the best available routing owner for the callback-format and sort-invariant choice.
